prosody.lang: The best time is sunrise, on the east terrace. For sunset, move to the west terrace. The summit is cold even in summer, so bring a jacket. For the best photo, stand on the west terrace with the giant heads in front of you and the setting sun behind them. Please don't touch the statues or climb on them. Entry is ticketed, and the
museum pass is valid. In winter the road can close because of snow, so check before you go. Local tip: leaving
Bridge and Arsameia into the same day. Locals call this the

tour. Did you know? The summit is about two thousand one hundred and fifty metres high, and it has been on the World Heritage List since 1987. Your next stop is Arsameia, about eleven kilometres by car, around twenty-five minutes.
